cases.name: bad_consecutive_heavy
cases.description: Same heavy lower-body session on consecutive days
violations: SAFETY: monday and tuesday both load ['glutes', 'hamstrings', 'quads'] above RPE 7.0 — consecutive heavy sessions for the same muscle group.
issues_found: Back-to-back heavy lower sessions on Monday and Tuesday violate recovery guidelines for large compound movements, which require 48–72 hours of recovery.
The plan's justification for back-to-back heavy lower sessions to maximize stimulus is not supported by evidence.
The plan does not align with hypertrophy rep range guidelines, as it uses 5 reps for squats, which is more strength-oriented.

cases.name: bad_deload_no_reduction

issues_found: Deload volume is too high, only reduced by 1% instead of the required 15%.
RPE levels are not sufficiently reduced for a deload week, potentially maintaining high fatigue.
The plan does not adequately address the acute load spike indicated in the fatigue report.
The plan lacks a clear rationale for exercise selection and rep ranges specific to the deload context.
